R7AE-duck-backcountry-0002.name: Unnamed wetland by Margaret Lake
R7AE-duck-backcountry-0002.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R7AE-duck-backcountry-0002.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: About 12 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.
Beside Necoslie River: backwater or oxbow (estimate).
Elevation 786 m: under 900 m, open water later in fall.

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 7-14, Region 7A Omineca. Near the MU line: check the MU map.

Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: Omineca South and Central. Closed between 4:30 a.m. and 8:00 a.m. from August 15 to August 31, between 5:30 a.m. and 9:00 a.m. from September 1 to September 30 and between 6:30 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. from October 1 to November 15. Synopsis map 7-3/24.

seasonRows.notes: District 7. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6.

plan: Drive: from District of Mackenzie, about 168 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 54.18935, -123.68482, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.0 km N, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 114 m, about 111 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 500 m S of the spot at 789 m (54.2294, -123.69704). Water: unnamed wetland 60 m N (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-14, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-04, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AE-duck-backcountry-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-14: about 7,285 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 4.33 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
